+    def filter_members(obj: Any, imported: bool) -> List[str]:
+        """Filter members based on imported_members flag."""
+        if imported:
+            return dir(obj)
+        else:
+            # For modules and classes, check if member is imported
+            members = []
+            for name in dir(obj):
+                try:
+                    value = safe_getattr(obj, name)
+                except AttributeError:
+                    continue
+                # Check if the member is imported
+                if isinstance(value, types.ModuleType):
+                    # It's imported if it's not a submodule of the current object
+                    if hasattr(obj, '__name__'):
+                        if not value.__name__.startswith(obj.__name__ + '.'):
+                            continue
+                elif hasattr(value, '__module__'):
+                    # It's imported if __module__ doesn't match the object's name
+                    if hasattr(obj, '__name__'):
+                        if value.__module__ != obj.__name__:
+                            continue
+                members.append(name)
+            return members
